Text to Video Nano Banana 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Create short AI-generated video clips (nano videos) from text prompts.
- Supports TXT, DOCX, PDF, and plain text files up to 200MB for prompt input.
- Cloud GPU backend delivers 720p MP4 videos in 20–40 seconds per prompt.
- Automatic handling of session and token management, including free starter credits.
- Seamless workflows: upload, prompt, preview, and export; supports batch and iterative editing.
